'''Leonid Polterovich''' ({{langx|he|לאוניד פולטרוביץ'}}; {{langx|ru|Леонид В. Полтерович}}; born 30 August 1963) is a [[Russia]]n-[[Israel]]i [[mathematician]] at [[Tel Aviv University]]. His research field includes [[symplectic geometry]] and [[dynamical systems]].

A native of [[Moscow]], Polterovich earned his undergraduate degree at [[Moscow State University]] in 1984. He moved to Israel after the [[Revolutions of 1989|collapse of communism]], earning his doctorate from [[Tel Aviv University]] in 1990. In 1996, he was awarded the [[EMS Prize]],<ref>{{cite web |url=http://newsletter.fbpnews.org/newslett/fbp-12/ps/12-33-33.ps |title=Archived copy |accessdate=2011-07-28 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120328062351/http://newsletter.fbpnews.org/newslett/fbp-12/ps/12-33-33.ps |archivedate=2012-03-28 }}</ref> in 1998 the [[Erdős Prize]], and in 2003 the Michael Bruno Memorial Award by [[Yad Hanadiv]].  In 1998, he was an invited speaker of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Berlin.<ref>{{cite book|author=Polterovich, Leonid|chapter=Geometry on the group of Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms|title=Doc. Math. (Bielefeld) Extra Vol. ICM Berlin, 1998, vol. II|year=1998|pages=401–410|chapter-url=https://www.elibm.org/ft/10011717000}}</ref> In 2016, he gave a plenary lecture at the 7th [[European Congress of Mathematics]] in Berlin.<ref>{{cite book|author=Polterovich, Leonid|chapter=Symplectic rigidity and quantum mechanics|title=European Congress of Mathematics, European Mathematical Society (EMS), Zürich, 2018 |pages=155–179|chapter-url=https://ems.press/books/standalone/148}}</ref> He was a member of the faculty of the [[University of Chicago]].

He was elected to the [[Academia Europaea]] in 2024.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Polterovich_Leonid|title=Leonid Polterovich|work=Members|publisher=Academia Europaea|access-date=2024-04-24}}</ref>

His brother, {{ill|Iosif Polterovich|fr}}, is a professor of mathematics at the [[University of Montreal]].<ref name="q573">{{cite web | title=Iosif Polterovich's Home Page | website=Accueil - Département de mathématiques et statistique | date=2012-11-11 | url=https://dms.umontreal.ca/~iossif/ }}</ref>
